notes.title: Hotfix - Version 1.01.1
notes.content:
Hello,

We released a hotfix Ver 1.01.1 today.

Hotfix Version 1.01.1 information

 Fixed an issue with controller operation in high refresh rate environment.
 Fixed an issue with screen tearing.
 Fixed an issue in which the probability of status condition was not calculated correctly when attacking the unit.


Thank you,

notes.title: Update Release - Version 1.01
notes.content:
Hello,

We released the Ver 1.01 update today.

Ver 1.01 update information:

 Fixed an issue with controller operation in high refresh rate environment.
 Fixed an issue that occurs when starting the game for the first time and opening the option for game graphics.
 Fixed an issue that occurs when equipping the knights and monsters or when sorting out their equipment.
 Fixed an issue where the quality of textures of the map during battles becomes lower.
 Fixed other minor issues.

We will update the information accordingly, as new information and patches are available.

Thank you!

notes.title: Version 1.01 Update announcement
notes.content:
Hello,
Thank you for playing “Brigandine: The Legend of Runersia”.

We are working on the bug fix the following bugs:
- Fixed an issue with controller operation in high refresh rate environment.
- Fixed an issue that occurs when starting the game for the first time and opening the option for game graphics.
- Fixed an issue that occurs when equipping the knights and monsters or when sorting out their equipment.
- Fixed an issue where the quality of textures of the map during battles becomes lower.
- Fixed other minor issues.

We will post an announcement once this update is applied.
Thank you for your patience in the meantime.
